verdict.rationale: The evidence describes only single-domain actions: per-domain auto-renew, per-domain WHOIS editing, one-click DNSSEC, and individual transfers. No documented bulk or multi-select operation appears. The Registrar API and the OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks a user could script around, which is not a product bulk-operations feature. A community member moving 'a bunch of domains' describes repeated individual transfers, not a bulk capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
